title: Pocketwire Rewards Training Note: The Repeat Redeemer Lift on Gift Cards
content:
Pocketwire Rewards members who have redeemed for gift cards repeatedly over the last twelve months receive a redeemer lift on the gift card rate.

## Rule

The gift card redeemer lift is 0.05 cents per point when the ledger carries at least 4 gift card redemptions dated within the last twelve months, 0.02 cents per point when it carries at least 2 but fewer than 4, and nothing when it carries fewer than 2; charity and cash redemptions are not counted.

The lift is added to the gift card rate per point before the rate is applied to the points redeemed.

A date lies within the last twelve months when it is later than the same calendar day twelve months before the handling date and not later than the handling date.

## Questions answered

Which redemptions count? Gift card redemption entries on the member's Pocketwire Rewards points ledger dated within the last twelve months. Charity and cash redemptions are not counted.

Four gift card redemptions in the window? 0.05 cents per point.

Three gift card redemptions and two charity donations? Only the three gift card redemptions count: 0.02 cents per point.

One gift card redemption? Nothing.

## Count and lift

| Gift card redemptions within the last twelve months | Lift (cents per point) |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 0.05 |
| 2 or 3 | 0.02 |
| 0 or 1 | nothing |
